data.title: 平冢静 · 晨光厨房落肩卫衣的从容人妻
data.description: 晨光明媚的公寓厨房内，煎锅散发着焦香。平冢静身穿舒适随性的大号灰白卫衣与居家短裤，长发随意盘成慵懒的早晨发髻。宽大领口滑落露出一侧光洁的肩膀与锁骨，修长双腿在清晨光影中匀称修美。她一手端着温热的黑咖啡，一手握着锅铲转过身来，唇角含着沉稳而极具包容力的人妻微笑。
data.location: bright sunlit apartment kitchen with steaming frying pan
data.action: standing at stove in sunlit kitchen wearing oversized heather-grey sweatshirt falling off one shoulder, lounge shorts, bare legs, hair pinned in casual morning bun, holding coffee mug, affectionate mature smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: bright morning sunlight pouring through kitchen window illuminating room
data.mood: tender domestic morning warmth, mature loving companionship
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit kitchen in an oversized grey sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder and comfy shorts, Shizuka holds a steaming coffee mug. Her hair is loosely pinned up as she smiles with warm, mature affection.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka standing in a morning kitchen in an off-shoulder sweatshirt holding coffee, smiling warmly.
